tools.name: blueprint_list
tools.description: Lists every available Blueprint with the business objects and actions it includes. Public and unauthenticated so customers can evaluate Hyperscale before signup.

tools.name: blueprint_retrieve
tools.description: Retrieves one Blueprint with its identity, business objects, lifecycle states, and available actions.

tools.name: extension_list
tools.description: Lists every catalog extension a Product can be recomposed with: the business instruments it contributes and the instruments the Product must already contain for the extension to attach. Public and unauthenticated, like Blueprint discovery.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "extension_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Lists every catalog extension a Product can be recomposed with: the business instruments it contributes and the instruments the Product must already contain for the extension to attach. Public and unauthenticated, like Blueprint discovery." → after: "List catalog extensions."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
